rv.q: Fun fact. I went into Music Theater Works’ production of Pippin knowing the songs, knowing the show, and knowing I’d have a good time.
This is a brave and bold interpretation of Stephen Schwartz's musical that I strongly applaud.
Although Music Theater Works' storytelling was visually stimulating and engaging, I found the actual story light on meaningful content. Still, its playfulness is a nice summer escape!
I cannot rave enough about the production's creativity!

cn.t: Music Theater Works delivers a visually eclectic, wacky take on "Pippin" that critics find entertaining and engaging. The production's pop culture-infused design and playful energy earn solid praise across the board.
